chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, raising it (to the Imam), said:
The fresh fish melts the fat of the eye.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating fresh fish according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the medicinal efficacy of fresh fish, specifically its ability to reduce ocular fat or cataracts, reflecting the early Shia emphasis on integrating practical health benefits with dietary laws. It underscores the tradition of viewing food not merely as sustenance but as a therapeutic agent, a concept deeply rooted in both Prophetic medicine and Shia scholarly discourse on physical well-being.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, raising it,
(He<sup>asws</sup>) said: ‘The fresh fish melts the fat of the eye’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa in a marfu‘ manner has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Fresh fish melts the fat of the eye.’”
